import unittest
from routekit.zones import canonical_zone


class ZoneTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_internal_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(canonical_zone(" East \n Gate "), "east-gate")

    def test_existing_hyphenated_key(self):
        self.assertEqual(canonical_zone(" SOUTH-2 "), "south-2")
===TEST_LABELS===
import unittest
from routekit.labels import zone_label


class LabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shared_zone_normalization(self):
        self.assertEqual(zone_label(" West  Wing "), "zone:west-wing")
===TEST_CLI===
import contextlib
import io
import json
import unittest
from routekit.cli import main


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_manifest_whitespace(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["manifest", " North\tDock "])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(output.getvalue()), {"zone_key": "north-dock"})
